notes_for_editor: One list entry (tnlandforms.us) is the only source for this tower. The list's coordinates sit close to Wikipedia's coordinates for the community. BLL-65209 is an identifier whose meaning the sources do not explain, so the story gives it only as an identifier. The Wikipedia history mentions a forest fire that destroyed houses and machinery in the Kirkland family's time; it does not mention a lookout, so it is not used. Neither NHLR nor the former-sites register lists it (absence checked against the full Georgia lists). Two WebSearch queries and the Georgia Forestry Commission history page (timed out, then refused) produced nothing on this tower. The brief's status and access stay unknown; no source supports a status, height, design or access level.
